chunks: “If it becomes possible for you to perform all your prayers, the obligatory ones and other than them, at al-Hatim, then do so, for it is the most virtuous spot on the face of the earth.”

key_terms.الْحَطِيمِ: al-Hatim, the sacred area adjacent to the Ka'bah
key_terms.تَهَيَّأَ: became possible or was made feasible
key_terms.غَيْرَهَا: other than them, meaning non-obligatory prayers

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about praying at al-Hatim?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام encourages performing both obligatory and supererogatory salat at al-Hatim whenever possible. The hadith highlights the exceptional virtue and sanctity of that location as the most excellent spot on the face of the earth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2170 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If you are able to pray all your prayers, obligatory and non-obligatory, at Al-Hatim, then do so, for it is the most virtuous spot on the face of the earth."
